name: Cube with Apex
definition: On the domain $[n]\cup\{\star\}$, the **cube-with-apex class** is $\mathcal A_n=\{A:A\subseteq[n]\}\cup\{\{\star\}\}$. Thus it contains the full $n$-cube on $[n]$ with coordinate $\star$ fixed to $0$, together with one apex having only $\star$ positive.
comments: The base cube is strongly shattered, but the apex activates $\star$ and makes every pair $\{\star,i\}$ fail to be shattered.
